program: Innobooster (Danmarks Innovationsfond / Innovationsfonden), track 200.000-1 mio. kr. under de minimis
stopper_list: S1 Financial foundation on the application date: at least 100.000 DKK risk capital (cash equity or unsecured convertible loan, owners allowed) or development grants within 3 years, or at least 250.000 DKK gross profit in one of the last 3 published accounts on cvr.dk; repayable or secured loans do not count. Founder fails: 40.000 share capital, owner loan and overdraft are debt, gross profit 95k/230k (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Innobooster-retningslinjer-De-minimis-Maj-2026.pdf s.1.2.2; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/programmer/innobooster/)
S2 No open round: 'Der er lige nu ingen søgemuligheder'; pool 4 closed 15 Oct 2026 at 12:00; no 2027 application windows published (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/programmer/innobooster/)
S3 Max 35 % of each budget item and of the total; 1,5 mio. on 2,8 mio. impossible; at least 65 % self-financed (guidelines s.1.5)
S4 Choose the track matching the grant requested (200k-1 mio. de minimis vs 1-5 mio. GBER); wrong track means administrative rejection (guidelines s.2.1)
S5 De minimis ceiling 300.000 EUR over 3 years including this grant (guidelines s.6)
S6 Danish CVR and EU SME definition incl. group firms over 25 % (guidelines s.1.2.1; program page)
S7 Not supported if the solution is already on the market and the project is mainly optimisation, further development, verification and documentation; v1 already sold (guidelines s.1.3)

S8 No extra attachments or letters of support; only the budget template, one illustration of at most 1 A4 page and one video link of at most 2 min without login; extra material can mean administrative rejection (guidelines s.2.2, s.2.4)
S9 Created and submitted in e-grant by a person who can sign for the company, with own MitID or username/password; non-e-grant submissions rejected (guidelines s.2.1, s.2.4)
S10 Staff costs at a fixed 750 DKK/h, max 135 h per person per month; owners at least 5 % on CVR or salaried ATP staff; part-time capped at paid hours; no hours with wage subsidy (guidelines s.1.4)
S11 Materials and equipment: invoices under 10.000 DKK excluded; equipment with value after the project counts only as depreciation; external invoices only (guidelines s.1.4)
S12 Excluded costs: ordinary operations, rent, transport, office, strategy, sales and marketing, market and customer analysis, investor work, auditor's statement (guidelines s.1.3)
S13 No costs before project start; start no earlier than the grant date and within 4 months of notice (guidelines s.1.4, s.1.6, s.4.1)

S14 Knowledge providers and suppliers with their deliverables named in the application; submit only when budget and supplier tasks are settled; no corrections, supplements or budget changes after submission (guidelines s.1.4, s.2.2)
S15 Average score under 4, or under 3 on any of the three equally weighted criteria, means no grant (guidelines s.3.1, s.3.3)
S16 Paid quarterly in arrears against approved accounts, 15 % held back until final accounts and auditor's statement are approved; company pre-finances (guidelines s.5.2, s.5.4; program page)
S17 Project must fall within a theme (here Grøn teknologi og innovation), contribution described in the form; competes within the theme (guidelines s.1.4 theme section)
